title: Trust Helping Smile
body:
Trust Helping Smile is a social welfare trust working since 2017 with the mission of spreading happiness and bringing smiles to people's faces.

Our journey began with social activities at Surdaas Blind School, Agra, Keetham, Old Age Home, Goverdhan, and Old Age Home, Bharatpur.

We believe that small acts of kindness can make a big difference in people's lives. We continue to work towards helping people and spreading happiness in society.

We welcome your valuable suggestions and feedback. Your support and ideas help us improve our work and serve society better.
